policy: Source-bound adjudication record for hardcoded UI literals. Only an explicit entry here can add a static literal to the lint corpus (scripts/export-copy.mjs appends it to its own locale). Every entry binds the exact candidate id and the original value SHA256 seen in the inventory, names locale, surface, trigger and a concrete review rationale, and declares state 'reviewed'. Stale hashes, unknown candidates, duplicates, missing rationale, non-UI or protected source material (quotes, paths, URLs, author text) and any non-'reviewed' state are rejected. Unknown candidates never enter the corpus automatically. Batch A has adjudicated zero static literals: all 3726 discovered candidates stay unreviewed, and global HTML coverage is not complete.
